content.text:
Recommend one private, pure iterator helper for period headlines, plus one shared feature component for the three metrics.

```rust
fn summarize_declared_totals<'a>(
    declarations: impl IntoIterator<Item = &'a MemberDeclaration>,
    calendar_year: CalendarYear,
) -> DeclaredGbpTotals {
    // Own all three period predicates and GBP coverage semantics.
}
```

Usage:

```rust
// Member:
summarize_declared_totals(history.declarations.iter(), calendar_year)

// Funder:
summarize_declared_totals(
    funding.declarations.iter().map(|source| &source.declaration),
    calendar_year,
)
```

`FunderFunding` already contains declarations with matching funding occurrences only; preserve that repository filtering and occurrence multiplicity. Count each returned declaration once per applicable period. Never derive totals from recipient rankings, which truncate at ten.

Within `domain/services/entity_details.rs`, use a small private GBP accumulator containing optional exact amount, declaration count and incompleteness. Keep existing `PeriodAggregate` solely for member historical currency/category breakdowns; remove its `gbp_total` method so GBP headline rules have one owner. `CurrentParliamentStart` and `CalendarYear` remain the canonical date rules. This requires another pass over member declarations, which is a small cost for substantially clearer ownership.

Alternative: a private stateful three-period aggregate, observed inside both existing loops. It avoids the second pass, but exposes lifecycle coordination (`new`, `observe`, `finish`) to callers and makes it easier for one caller to omit observations. Prefer the pure helper.

Add `declared_totals: DeclaredGbpTotals` directly to `FunderDetails` and its HTTP response. Implement `From<DeclaredGbpTotals>` for the existing response type so both endpoints serialize identically. Make `summarize_funder` accept `CalendarYear`, selected by the service just as members do. Preserve all existing funder fields and rankings.

Frontend:

```svelte
<!-- DeclaredTotals.svelte, shared feature component -->
<DeclaredTotals
  totals={details.declaredTotals}
  firstRegisteredAt={optionalExistingMemberDate}
/>
```

Accept typed `DeclaredGbpTotals`, render existing member order/layout/labels and completeness states, and use the same component from both identity headers. Keep it outside `lib/ui`: period labels, GBP formatting and backend financial models belong to the feature layer. Reuse the existing server `declaredTotals()` parser; require the new funder field without fallback sums.

Preserved behavior: exact decimal strings; null distinct from zero; unknown categories included; unknown currency and missing GBP amounts mark incomplete; known foreign currencies excluded without incompleteness; undated declarations historical only; term begins inclusively on 9 July 2024; calendar year comes from backend UTC. Member historical “since” wording can remain optional without adding funder date fields solely for presentation.

Verification should compare both entity paths against shared period fixtures, including boundary dates, null/zero, foreign/unknown currencies, repeated matching occurrences, and a declaration containing a large unrelated funder amount. Assert existing funder rankings/currency outputs remain identical and both identities render the three authoritative values.
